edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults combining grapefruit with susceptible calcium-channel blockers
edges.mechanism: The same CYP3A4 inhibition can raise levels of some calcium-channel blockers enough to exaggerate vasodilation and produce symptomatic hypotension.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2025 Methaneethorn meta analysis in Complement Ther Med, which suggests that grapefruit- calcium channel blocker interaction tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes for hypotension. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
